name: Kivo Studio
tagline: AI workspace for films, ads and game assets
description: Kivo Studio is an AI workspace for professional creators and small studios working on games, anime, virtual humans, short AI films and TV commercials. It includes an asset library for images, video and sound, reusable prompts with saved versions, lower-cost Drafts to compare candidates, and Production to finish a chosen shot in 1080p or 4K with a supported model. Motion references can be converted to depth video at no credit cost and reused in later shots. Kivo also offers an MCP integration. The public pricing page lists one-time credit packs (no subscription and no automatic renewal) from $2.00 for 120 credits up to $200.00 for 14,500 credits, and says generation is charged after successful delivery. Pack amounts shown on that page are 120, 520, 2,100, 4,300 and 14,500 credits. The live pricing page currently says credit top-ups are coming soon and checkout is not open yet; packages are shown for reference.
